topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: When I heard that my best friend is moving across the country, I took a deep breath. It's a big change, but I know they're excited about this new adventure. I’m choosing to focus on how this move could bring new opportunities and experiences for them. We've been through so much together, and I truly believe that the bond we have won't be diminished by distance. I plan to make the most of the time we have left, creating more memories that we can look back on fondly. Plus, we’ve already started brainstorming fun ways to stay in touch and visit each other whenever we can. It’s a transition, but I’m confident we’ll navigate it together.
